asked.item: How to turn off the watermark
Customer sent watermark set to empty but word still shows

verdict.reason: The template page says the parameter is named `watemark`, not `watermark`, and that setting it to an empty string hides the watermark.

steps.text: For this template, the parameter name is `watemark`, not `watermark`.
To hide the watermark, set `watemark` to `""` (empty string).
